function syncWebEngagementFromLog_() {
  const ss = getSalesSpreadsheet_();
  const webSh = ss.getSheetByName('Web行動ログ');
  const queueSh = ss.getSheetByName(SALES_IMPORT_APP.QUEUE_SHEET);
  if (!webSh || !queueSh) return {rows:0, mapped:0, updated:0, warning:'Web行動ログなし'};

  const webValues = webSh.getDataRange().getValues();
  if (webValues.length <= 1) {
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().setProperty('WEB_ENGAGEMENT_LAST_SYNC', formatNow_());
    return {rows:0, mapped:0, updated:0, warning:''};
  }

  const wh = headerMap_(webValues[0]);
  validateHeaders_(wh, ['送信管理ID','イベント日時','ページ種別','ページパス','データソース'], 'Web行動ログ');

  const byId = {};
  let mapped = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < webValues.length; i++) {
    const row = webValues[i];
    const deliveryId = clean_(value_(row, wh, '送信管理ID'));
    if (!deliveryId) continue;

    const eventAt = asDate_(value_(row, wh, 'イベント日時'));
    if (!eventAt) continue;

    const pageType = clean_(value_(row, wh, 'ページ種別'));
    const pagePath = clean_(value_(row, wh, 'ページパス'));
    const dataSource = clean_(value_(row, wh, 'データソース'));
    // TEST events remain in existing Web行動ログ for audit, but never
    // advance live customer last-reaction timestamps or sales KPIs.
    if (pageType.startsWith('TEST_') || dataSource === 'VERCEL_WEB_EVENT_TEST') continue;
    if (!byId[deliveryId]) byId[deliveryId] = {count:0,last:null,lastType:'',lastPath:''};
    byId[deliveryId].count++;
    mapped++;

    if (!byId[deliveryId].last || eventAt.getTime() > byId[deliveryId].last.getTime()) {
      byId[deliveryId].last = eventAt;
      byId[deliveryId].lastType = pageType;
      byId[deliveryId].lastPath = pagePath;
    }
  }

  const queueValues = queueSh.getDataRange().getValues();
  const qh = headerMap_(queueValues[0]);
  validateHeaders_(qh, ['送信管理ID','最終反応日時'], SALES_IMPORT_APP.QUEUE_SHEET);

  let updated = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < queueValues.length; i++) {
    const deliveryId = clean_(value_(queueValues[i], qh, '送信管理ID'));
    const stat = byId[deliveryId];
    if (!deliveryId || !stat || !stat.last) continue;

    const current = asDate_(value_(queueValues[i], qh, '最終反応日時'));
    if (!current || stat.last.getTime() > current.getTime()) {
      setQueueValue_(queueSh, i + 1, qh, '最終反応日時', stat.last);
      updated++;
    }
  }

  PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().setProperty('WEB_ENGAGEMENT_LAST_SYNC', formatNow_());
  PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().setProperty('WEB_ENGAGEMENT_SUMMARY_JSON', JSON.stringify(byId));
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  return {rows:webValues.length - 1, mapped:mapped, updated:updated, warning:''};
}
